rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing a different opinion or belief.

example.english: I disagree with what you’re saying.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 tung4 ji3 nei5 gam3 joeng6 gong2

rows.note: Use this when figures, results, records, or other things fail to match or correspond.

example.english: These two records disagree with each other.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 fan6 gei3 luk6 deoi3 m4 soeng6 wo3
